semantics.sourceClosure: Production cmd/bd and the union of module-owned packages transitively reachable from cmd/bd in the declared profiles; external dependency internals are excluded.
semantics.outputBoundary: This inventory owns selectors, precedence, stdin sources, completion rules, and stdout/stderr channels. M02-02 owns exact bytes and schemas. M02-03 owns exits and diagnostics.
semantics.exclusionAuthority: A repository maintainer must approve exclusions. The generated source location and snippet digest make source drift invalidate the reviewed disposition.

rules.summary: Actor selection checks the explicit flag, BEADS_ACTOR, deprecated BD_ACTOR, Git configuration, USER, then unknown.
BD_NAME changes the displayed root name but never the stable command identity.
Shared text input accepts exactly one of stdin, file, explicit text flag, or positional text. Stdin trailing CR and LF are trimmed; file bytes remain unchanged.
Issue ID completion may open the selected task store read-only, returns ID and title candidates, and suppresses file completion.
The hidden format selector aliases JSON mode. JSON, quiet, verbose, color, and terminal selectors are inventoried here; exact output bytes remain M02-02.
